item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Kinetic 1.1.0
item.description:
Native Git client for macOS

Kinetic is a native Git client for macOS 26 Tahoe and later versions, consolidating branch history, code diffs, staged commits, conflict resolution, and remote repository operations into a single window. The software directly calls the Git installed on Mac, using the existing configuration, hooks, credential helper, and SSH agent, making it easy to use in conjunction with terminal workflows. The branch graph clearly displays commits, merges, tags, and remote references. It supports searching for commit information, authors, hashes, and code changes, and provides unified, two-column, and change-block-linked diff views. Users can stage or discard changes by line or by block, undo actions through the undo option, and snapshots of discarded files are retained for two weeks. The Command Palette supports quick execution and operation previews, and can also be connected to Claude Code, Codex, API, or Ollama to convert natural language requests into Git commands for confirmation. The software supports multiple code hosting platforms, commit signature verification, interactive rebase, working trees, and submodules. It also features a native interface, light and dark themes, VoiceOver labels, and remappable shortcuts, making it suitable for both daily development and the maintenance of complex repositories.

item.title: Sonant 1.1.9
item.description:
Music Controls in the macOS Menu Bar

Sonant is a menu bar music control tool for Mac that supports Apple Music and Spotify. It automatically recognizes the player in use and displays album covers, song information, and real-time visualizations in a capsule-style menu bar, without taking up space in the Dock while listening. Users can directly play, pause, skip songs, or drag the progress bar to seek. They can also control music in other apps using global hotkeys. Long-press the capsule to expand the cover art, synchronized lyrics, and a larger progress bar. You can also drag it out of the menu bar to turn it into a floating panel that can be displayed across desktop spaces and full-screen apps. The software supports customizing display elements and title formats, offers a sleep timer ranging from fifteen to ninety minutes, allows copying the link of the current song, and stores local data such as daily and weekly listening durations, continuous listening records, and statistics on popular artists. Three power modes adjust the visual refresh rate and automatically follow macOS Low Power Mode. The software requires macOS 14.2 or later and an Apple chip. It is suitable for users who want to view songs and control playback at any time while maintaining a clean desktop and good battery life.

item.title: Haptiker 1.1.5
item.description:
macOS Trackpad Edge Gestures

Haptiker is a macOS menu bar tool that transforms the four edges of your Mac's trackpad into everyday control areas: swipe up and down on the right side to adjust the volume, swipe on the left side to adjust the screen brightness, swipe horizontally at the top to control the keyboard backlight, and swipe at the bottom to enable recent app switching and app browsing as needed. Brightness adjustment follows the screen where the cursor is located. On Apple Silicon Macs, compatible external displays can also be controlled via the built-in DDC/CI, with each screen maintaining its own independent brightness. The software offers double-click mute and custom volume and brightness presets, supports smooth adjustment and multi-step increments, and allows for temporary fine control by holding down the Shift key. Users can set the edge width, trigger sensitivity, swap left and right functions, and activate buttons, receiving clear feedback through haptic feedback, on-screen prompts, and a fixed cursor during adjustments. Gestures must be initiated with a single finger from the edge and moved along the edge. Combined with limits on contact time and swipe distance, this reduces accidental touches and does not interfere with two-finger scrolling.

item.title: Golosok 1.13.10
item.description:
Mac Offline Speech-to-Text

Golosok is a native speech dictation and offline transcription tool for Apple Silicon Macs. It uses the GigaAM v3 and Whisper Large v3 speech recognition models, with all inference performed locally. There is no need to upload audio to the cloud, making it suitable for privacy-conscious daily input, work communication, and audio-visual data organization. You can start or end dictation by using the global shortcut key combination of Option + Space. The recognized text will be directly inserted into the input field where the cursor is currently positioned. This feature can be used in applications such as VS Code, Notion, Telegram, Xcode, Obsidian, and Slack. The software offers a push-to-talk mode. After releasing the shortcut key, the speech is transcribed and pasted. You can also cancel the current recording by pressing Esc. Recognition focuses on Russian, English, technical slang, and mixed Russian-English expressions, and supports automatic punctuation. File processing supports audio and video formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, and WebM, and can transcribe files of various lengths in batches offline.

item.title: Pesty 1.3.0
item.description:
Paste Open Source Alternative Software

Pesty is a native, open-source clipboard management tool for macOS 14 and later, supporting both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. It is developed using Swift and SwiftUI, with no third-party dependencies. It organizes copied plain text, rich text, links, images, files, and colors into a searchable history. A global shortcut key brings up a translucent horizontal panel at the bottom of the screen, helping users identify items through the source app's unique color scheme, icon, content preview, and copy time. Frequently used content can be saved to a Favorites board with a name and color tag for long-term retention and repeated access. You can also choose to sync history and Favorites boards across multiple Macs via iCloud Drive. The software supports arrow key navigation, number key selection, and plain text pasting, making it suitable for work scenarios involving frequent handling of data, code, and repetitive text. History is saved locally by default, ignores content marked as hidden by password managers, and supports pausing clipboard monitoring.

item.title: MacSense 0.2.0
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Performance Monitoring

MacSense is a macOS system monitoring tool with a native SwiftUI interface. It displays CPU, memory, GPU, battery, disk, network, temperature, and fan speed in a dashboard, along with real-time charts and hardware information, making it easy to view the operating status of your Mac. The software can display the load of each core of the processor, memory pressure and swap space, battery health estimates and cycle counts, and provide disk read and write statistics, speed tests, and basic SMART information. For detailed NVMe SMART information, smartctl needs to be installed separately. Application Management supports statistics on the space occupied by programs and matching associated files. The cleanup module can scan caches, logs, development data, and downloaded content. Selected files are moved to the Trash after confirmation, and some directories are for viewing only. Users can adjust the monitoring panel, menu bar indicators, themes, and refresh intervals, and can also pause refreshing or export text reports. The software supports instant switching between five languages, including Simplified Chinese. Monitoring data is processed locally, and hardware details, process lists, or file lists are not uploaded.

item.title: Veil 1.14.2
item.description:
Multi-core VPN proxy tool

Veil is a native macOS VPN and proxy client built with SwiftUI, integrating both Xray-core and sing-box cores. It automatically selects the engine based on the server protocol and supports VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, and AnyTLS. The software offers two modes: system proxy and TUN full-traffic tunneling. The former is suitable for applications that support proxies, such as browsers, while the latter is suitable for network traffic from terminals, games, and UDP, among others. Built-in subscription grouping, scheduled updates, display of data usage and expiration information. Supports batch import of links, camera scanning, and QR code recognition from images. The routing feature offers presets such as global, bypass LAN, and custom. It allows configuration of proxies, direct connections, or blocking based on domain names, IP addresses, and ports, and loads a rule database to block ads and trackers. Users can quickly connect to and switch between nodes via the menu bar, and filter servers using latency tests, sorting, and search functions.

item.title: Shatl 1.0.6
item.description:
Open-source BT download client

Shatl is a lightweight, open-source BitTorrent client for Apple Silicon Macs, built on libtorrent and supporting macOS 26 and later. The software can open torrent files and magnet links, allowing you to view the content, select the desired files, and specify the save location before starting the download, making the download scope and storage arrangement clearer. The interface offers two display modes: simplified indicators and detailed numerical values, making it easy to quickly grasp progress or view precise data. The three performance presets – Halo, Orbit, and Nova – reduce the need for manual adjustments of underlying parameters. Users can set easily recognizable aliases for torrents while retaining their original names, and resume download sessions, including tasks that need to be processed, when restarting. Shatl features a SwiftUI and Liquid Glass interface, incorporating system accent colors, notifications, and reduced motion settings. It offers seven interface languages, including Simplified Chinese, and provides in-app updates through Sparkle.

item.title: BatchOutput DOC 3.0.1
item.description:
Batch Export of Word Documents

BatchOutput DOC is a macOS document batch output tool developed by Zevrix Solutions, specifically designed to automate the printing of Microsoft Word files and export them to PDF. Users simply add the Word documents to be processed to the task list and set the output parameters, and the software will automatically perform the subsequent operations, reducing the need to open files one by one and repeat printing or exporting steps. It is ideal for batch processing office documents, reports, and archived materials. The software supports saving each page of a document as a separate PDF and can include variables such as date, username, and page number in the output file name, making it easy to identify and organize files. For documents containing images, the size of the PDF can be reduced by lowering the image resolution and compressing the images, making it easier to store and transmit. Quartz filters can also be used to adjust and convert PDF colors to meet different output requirements. For data that requires protection, the software provides PDF encryption and password protection functions, making it convenient to configure file protection during batch output.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.10.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: Stats 3.1.0
item.description:
System monitor for the menu bar

Stats is a system monitoring tool that lives in the macOS menu bar and shows live metrics: battery level, Bluetooth device connections, CPU frequency (Intel only), CPU usage, disk usage, fan speed, GPU usage, memory, network usage, and temperature, voltage and power from various sensors. It supports many interface languages, several menu bar styles (bar chart, pie chart, line graph, numbers), customizable metrics, and alerts that play a sound or send a notification when a threshold is reached.

item.title: WailBrew 0.14.3
item.description:
Homebrew Graphical Interface Management Tool

WailBrew is a sleek and minimalist Homebrew package management graphical user interface (GUI) designed for macOS, making the use of command-line tools intuitive and modern. Users can easily install, update, and uninstall software packages with just a few simple clicks, without having to memorize complex commands or deal with terminal syntax. Built on the solid foundation of Homebrew, WailBrew offers a secure operation process and comprehensive error handling to ensure smooth package management. It supports real-time filtering and detailed information searches, helping users manage thousands of formulas and cask applications. WailBrew is not only suitable for ordinary users who prefer graphical interfaces, but also provides developers with a way to install via the Homebrew command line, demonstrating its practicality and flexibility. WailBrew makes Homebrew's powerful features even easier to use through a beautiful interface. WailBrew is a minimalist and visually appealing graphical user interface (GUI) for Homebrew package management. It offers macOS users an intuitive and modern operating experience, making the powerful capabilities of command-line tools easily accessible.

item.title: RepoBar 0.10.5
item.description:
Native macOS open-source repository tool

RepoBar is a native macOS menu bar tool for monitoring and maintaining GitHub repositories, designed for maintainers, developers, and team members who need to keep track of multiple projects simultaneously. It consolidates CI status, issues, pull requests, releases, contribution heatmaps, local checkout directories, branch synchronization, rate limits, and GitHub Enterprise accounts into a drop-down menu next to the clock, reducing the time spent switching back and forth between browser tabs and dashboards. The software can scan local project folders and match them with GitHub repositories, displaying the current branch, upstream tracking, ahead/behind status, dirty files, and worktree status alongside remote information. It also provides SQLite caching, ETag reuse, offline archive import, and gitcrawl.sh snapshot reading capabilities, allowing you to view Issue and PR lists even when GitHub is rate-limited or the network is unavailable.

item.title: GitHub Stars Manager 0.9.1
item.description:
GitHub Repository Stars Admin Tool

GithubStarsManager is a cross-platform GitHub resource management tool for developers that centralizes Stars, Forks, and Gists to transform scattered collection content into a searchable, categorizable, and traceable personal knowledge base. The software uses AI to analyze the README, documents, submission records and code structure of the warehouse, automatically generates summaries, tags and platform information, and establishes a clear technical data system through 14 categories of preset classification and custom classification. Natural language search, vector semantic search, and AI rearrangement can help users locate repositories by intention, and the repository Q&A assistant provides source-based answers based on README, submissions, and Issues. Users can also track version releases, identify platform download links, sync forks, trigger GitHub Actions, manage Gists, and browse trending items.

item.title: OpenClip 1.10.0
item.description:
PopClip, an open-source alternative to the macOS floating productivity tool

OpenClip is a native floating action bar tool for macOS, designed to reduce switching between different applications. Users simply select text and use a shortcut to bring up the action bar to quickly copy, calculate, format, or convert text, run custom scripts, or invoke extensions suitable for the current context. It supports grammar correction, content summarization, translation, spell checking, and inline mathematical calculations, and instantly presents results in a native-style floating card. OpenClip offers a command panel and over 100 official extensions, enabling quick actions to be triggered from any application. It also allows users to create custom workflows using JavaScript, AppleScript, and Shell. The software is compatible with macOS 14 Sonoma and later versions, is open source under the MIT License, is completely free, and emphasizes zero tracking. It is suitable for writers, developers, researchers, and everyday office users who need to process text, numbers, and automated tasks frequently.

item.title: VutronMusic 4.0.0
item.description:
Third-party NetEase Cloud Music Player for macOS

VutronMusic is an open-source, third-party NetEase Cloud Music player for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Developed using technologies such as Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Fastify, and better-sqlite3, it features an elegant interface design and supports online music, local music libraries, and personal streaming services. The software supports playing local songs, creating offline playlists, and reading embedded or external album covers and lyrics in audio files. It is compatible with LRC and word-by-word lyric formats, and can also supplement song information through online data matching. In terms of streaming media, it can connect to Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby, making it easy to centrally access self-built music resources. VutronMusic offers desktop lyrics, macOS status bar lyrics, and Touch Bar lyrics display, ensuring lyrics remain visible in various usage scenarios. The audio tools include sound effect settings, pitch shifting, and tempo adjustment, accommodating needs for vocal practice, dictation, and personalized listening.

item.title: Movist Pro 2.21.1
item.description:
Professional Media Player for macOS

Movist Pro is a professional media player for macOS that supports the playback of local videos, music files, and content from web pages and web servers. Its interface and performance have been optimized for modern Mac systems. It can leverage hardware acceleration to decode H.265 and HEVC videos, smoothly handle 4K UHD footage, and simultaneously reduce processor usage and power consumption. The player offers AirPlay screen mirroring, allowing you to send videos to Apple TV or compatible smart TVs, with automatic optimization of picture quality and subtitles. Users can flexibly manage multilingual audio and video tracks, set the position, style, number of lines, and reading speed of subtitles, and also use subtitle reading to assist with language learning. Movist supports SMB, SFTP, FTP, and WebDAV network access, with a built-in buffering mechanism to handle unstable connections. It also offers features such as HDR tone mapping, 10-bit color, CoreImage filters, zoom, rotation, flip, audio equalizer, digital output, playlists, shortcuts, and Touch Bar, making it suitable for everyday viewing, media collections, cross-device playback, and fine-tuned playback control.

item.title: Vidnip 2.0.10
item.description:
macOS Web Video Sniffer Downloader

Vidnip is a video download and media management software for Apple Silicon Mac that supports macOS 14 and above, combining web video detection, download, format conversion, and local playback in one app. After pasting the page link, the software can identify MP4, WebM, HLS/m3u8 and dash videos through traffic monitoring. Combined with the yt-dlp engine, it covers more than 1800 sites, automatically downloads segments in parallel and merges them into a playable MP4, supporting image quality selection, breakpoint continuation, batch link processing and channel update subscription. The built-in video library organizes content by source, filters unwatched items and remembers playback progress; The music library supports audio extraction, album and artist browsing, tag management, and scrolling lyrics. The subtitle feature supports downloading site subtitles, exporting text, and generating subtitles or lyrics using native speech recognition on macOS 26 and above. With the iPhone app, you can also sync music, transfer videos, play back, and remotely send download links.

item.title: StatSpace 1.5.0
item.description:
macOS menu bar system monitoring

Stat Space is a macOS menu bar system monitoring tool for developers and AI programmers that supports Macs with Apple Silicon chips, macOS 14 Sonoma, or newer. The software centrally displays CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, fan, and battery status, and keeps a 30-day, minute-level history locally, making it easy to track load changes. It can integrate the auxiliary process into its own application, trace the listening port to the project directory and the startup source, identify the development process left after the end of the Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor sessions, and centrally clean up after confirmation. Users can also view AI tool usage limits, adjust volume independently for each app, check microphone occupancy, peripheral connectivity, and why sleep is blocked. The menu bar supports a variety of charts, themes, and shortcuts. It works with desktop widgets, custom home pages, network diagnostics, storage cleanup, and CLI and MCP interfaces to integrate system status and development environment management into the same interface.

item.title: Caxton 2.3.1
item.description:
macOS Large File Editor

Caxton is a native large file editor for macOS that handles production logs, database export files, oversized CSV, JSON exports, and crash reports that are hard to open with a regular text editor. It uses Memory-mapped I/O, piece-table document model and hierarchical line indexing to fully open and index files up to 10GB and more than 80 million lines, while only rendering the current viewport content, so that ultra-long single-line compressed files can also be scrolled smoothly. The software provides log-following mode, full-text search, regular matching, batch replacement, multi-conditional filtering, original line number retention and large file segmentation opening functions; CSV mode supports automatic delimiter recognition, header freezing, type inference, million-level row and column sorting, cell editing, column splitting, merge extraction and deduplication. Built on AppKit and Swift, Caxton does not rely on Electron or web views, supports dark mode, tabs, native file dialogs, system services, and print capabilities. Files are left native by default, are not uploaded, are not processed in the cloud, and do not include telemetry.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.42
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Splice 1.4.9
item.description:
Quick Input of Animated Emojis on Mac

Splice is a quick emoji and GIF input tool for macOS. It brings Slack-like colon-triggered input and animated GIF search to any input context in the system, allowing users to find the right reaction with just a few keystrokes in chats, emails, documents, or collaboration tools. It supports the input of trigger words like :sparkles, which then displays matching emojis as inline candidates. Combined with fuzzy search, usage frequency sorting, and shortcut number selection, it reduces the time spent manually searching. The software also offers a full Emoji Board and GIF Board, making it easy to browse, search, and insert emojis or animated GIFs. GIFs can be sent as links or files, and frequently used GIFs can be saved and assigned custom keywords. Both keyboard shortcuts and triggers can be customized, making the overall experience more suitable for Mac users who engage in heavy messaging, community management, remote collaboration, and those who like to use emojis to express tone.

item.title: Widgetify 4.56
item.description:
Personalized desktop design tools

Widgetify is a desktop personalization tool designed for macOS that provides a rich set of highly customizable widgets that allow users to design their desktop to their liking, making it a place to remind themselves of important people, places, and words. With Widgetify, users can showcase their personal photos, count down to upcoming events, keep popular app shortcuts on desktop, see the weather at a glance, and more. Each widget can be precisely tuned to match the look and functionality users expect, including a wide selection of colors, backgrounds, sizes, and themes. Widgetify enables users to create and easily change the perfect desktop wall look over time. These include popular widgets such as photo browsing, music playback status controls (with support for Spotify, Apple Music, and lyrics), custom date and time clocks, app shortcuts and folder organizers, Day Master, to-dos and notes, weather conditions and forecasts, time zone tracking, and statistics and page turn clocks. Widgetify is software that lets you personalize your desktop like never before, offering a wide range of highly customizable widgets.

item.title: Structured 4.6.9
item.description:
Intelligent scheduling planning tool

Structured, an app that helps users stay in control of their daily lives by bringing together calendars, to-dos, routines, and habits through a clear visual timeline, has attracted more than 1.5 million active users, making them feel calmer, more focused, and able to efficiently complete their daily tasks. Perfect for work, study, travel, and busy ADHD thinking, the app takes just a few minutes to plan and stay focused throughout the day. Users can intuitively organize daily and weekly tasks, capture ideas at any time and organize them later, sync between iPhones, iPads, Apple Watches, and Macs, split large projects into notes and subtasks, and have a pomodoro focus timer, real-time activities, and interactive widgets to help keep users on track. Users can also personalize their schedule with color coding and hundreds of icons, and enjoy accessibility features like VoiceOver, voice control, friendly fonts, and multilingualism.

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.5.1
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: Mac 4 Breakfast 0.3.31
item.description:
Menu Bar Battery All-in-One Monitor

Mac 4 Breakfast is a native macOS battery management and monitoring tool that brings together battery health, cycle count, capacity, real-time power consumption, voltage, temperature, estimated time remaining, and charging status, all of which are hidden by default in the system, and displays them in the menu bar. It not only focuses on the Mac's built-in battery but also aggregates battery information from Apple devices such as iPhones, iPads, AirPods, Apple Watches, and Magic peripherals. It helps users understand battery changes through customizable menu bar indicators, smart reminders, sleep power consumption detection, app power consumption statistics, and battery report cards. The software processes data natively, is compatible with Apple Silicon, and supports charging connection animations, target battery level unplug reminders, low battery predictions, overheating cause prompts, health trend predictions, and export reports. It is suitable for Mac users who want to extend battery life in a lightweight way, identify power-consuming apps, and monitor the battery status of their entire set of Apple devices.
